posts.title: Jakarta, September 1992: the Non-Aligned Movement met for the first time since the Soviet Union collapsed — and decided it still mattered.
caption: Jakarta, September 1992: the Non-Aligned Movement met for the first time since the Soviet Union collapsed — and decided it still mattered.

The tenth NAM (Non-Aligned Movement) summit ran 1–6 September 1992 at the Jakarta Convention Center. The New York Times counted 108 member nations with more than half the world's people; about 60 heads of state or government attended. Brunei, Guatemala, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines and Uzbekistan joined, and Cambodia returned. Yugoslavia, the outgoing chair, was breaking apart.

The headline document, "The Jakarta Message: A Call for Collective Action and the Democratization of International Relations", recast non-alignment for a world without two blocs. It called for North–South dialogue "based on genuine interdependence", South–South cooperation on "collective self-reliance", and action on "the crushing burden of debt and debt servicing". On Africa's economic crisis it said: "Africa deserves our special attention."

Indonesia took the chair for 1992–1995, after lobbying for it at Harare and Belgrade. President Soeharto opened the summit beside UN Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali and urged members to start South–South projects without waiting for everyone. In July 1993 he carried NAM's call for dialogue and a memorandum on debt to Tokyo, meeting G7 (Group of Seven) host Kiichi Miyazawa before the summit. Miyazawa said paragraphs 13 and 14 of the G7 declaration reflected those talks, though Soeharto was not allowed to address the Seven.
Survival was the low bar. Jakarta tried to turn a Cold War stance into an economic agenda.

posts.title: Nigeria ingin litiumnya diolah di dalam negeri. Modal China sudah lebih dulu membangun pabriknya.
caption: Nigeria ingin litiumnya diolah di dalam negeri. Modal China sudah lebih dulu membangun pabriknya.

Pada 2 Juli 2026, Nigeria meresmikan pabrik pengolahan litium Diamond New Energy di Endo, Negara Bagian Nasarawa: investasi sekitar US$250 juta, kapasitas 6.000 ton bijih per hari, dibangun bersama Jiuling Lithium dan Canmax Technologies dari China. Menurut Menteri Pengembangan Mineral Padat Dele Alake, investasi China di pengolahan litium Nigeria sudah melampaui US$1,3 miliar sejak September 2023.

Jalur bijih mentah belum tertutup. Pada 18 Agustus, Chariot Resources (bursa Australia, ASX) meneken term sheet dengan C&D (Hainan) dan ZhongNuo Energy untuk program DSO (direct shipping ore, bijih yang dikirim tanpa diolah) hingga 240.000 ton pada fase pertama, masih bersyarat. Pada 23 September, Nigeria dan Amerika Serikat meneken Kerangka Mineral Kritis di New York, tanpa rincian proyek dan pendanaan. RUU yang mendorong nilai tambah lokal sebelum ekspor dikembalikan Presiden Tinubu ke parlemen pada Juli karena cacat hukum.

Untuk Indonesia, ini cermin yang dekat. PBB memasukkan Nigeria dan Indonesia ke dalam kelompok pertama Country Support Mechanism (mekanisme dukungan negara) untuk mineral transisi energi kritis, bersama Guinea, Madagaskar, Zambia, dan Zimbabwe. Indonesia lebih dulu melarang ekspor bijih nikel sejak 2020; Nigeria kini menguji resep serupa untuk litium.

Contract: two-year fixed term, with the possibility of renewal.

Asia–Africa angle: members include Indonesia; Nigeria, Gabon, Algeria and Libya; plus Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Iran and Iraq (and Ecuador and Venezuela). The Fund finances projects only in non-member developing countries — about US$13.2 billion approved for Africa (53 countries) and about US$10.6 billion for Asia (43 partners). Disbursements to those corridors run through this desk.

posts.title: Africa’s payment rail is aiming at China and India.
caption: Africa’s payment rail is aiming at China and India.

The Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS) — the cross-border network built by the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) with the African Union (AU) for the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) — says it expects links to major Chinese and Indian payment systems by the first quarter of 2027.

That target follows a year of sharp growth: transaction volumes up about 1,000 percent and values up about 120 percent between comparable periods in 2025 and 2026, according to a September briefing in Lagos by chief executive Mike Ogbalu III. PAPSS now spans more than 30 African countries, 24 central banks and more than 200 banks and payment firms.

The pitch is simpler settlement for Africa–Asia trade without routing every payment through hard-currency correspondent banks. What is still missing: named counterparties, published agreements, and confirmation that Q1 2027 will mean live rails rather than more talks.
Next checkpoint: PAPSS COWRY 2026 in Addis Ababa, Nov. 26–27.

posts.title: Belgrade, September 1989: the Non-Aligned Movement returned to the city of its first summit — and launched a smaller economic club on the sidelines.
caption: Belgrade, September 1989: the Non-Aligned Movement returned to the city of its first summit — and launched a smaller economic club on the sidelines.

The ninth NAM (Non-Aligned Movement) summit met 4–7 September 1989 at the Sava Centar. Janez Drnovšek took the chair from Zimbabwe’s Robert Mugabe. Venezuela joined as a full member (102 countries). UPI put the Movement at about 2.3 billion people — roughly 44.5% of the world — and noted a draft tone favouring dialogue with the industrial North over confrontation.

Out of Belgrade came the G15 (Group of Fifteen): the Summit Level Group of Developing Countries, aimed at practical South–South cooperation and a steadier North–South conversation. Founding members included Indonesia, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Egypt, Brazil, and Yugoslavia. The first G15 summit followed in Kuala Lumpur, 1–3 June 1990, hosted by Mahathir Mohamad; President Soeharto attended. Contemporary reporting tied the idea to South Commission work under Julius Nyerere.

Indonesia’s angle was clear. Soeharto led the Belgrade delegation with State Secretary Moerdiono; Foreign Minister Ali Alatas was already there for the preparatory ministerial. Soeharto attended the opening, planted a friendship tree at the Sava Centar, and was scheduled to speak. At Harare (1986) and Belgrade (1989), Jakarta lobbied for the NAM chair without winning it that cycle. The chair came in Accra in September 1991 — clearing the path to NAM X in Jakarta, 1–6 September 1992.
Bandung gave the South a voice. Belgrade 1989 gave it a smaller table for economic homework.

posts.title: Harga kobalt Kongo turun 31% dalam tiga bulan. Smelter nikel Indonesia ikut tertekan.
caption: Harga kobalt Kongo turun 31% dalam tiga bulan. Smelter nikel Indonesia ikut tertekan.

Menurut USGS (Survei Geologi Amerika Serikat), RD Kongo (Republik Demokratik Kongo) memasok sekitar 73% kobalt tambang dunia pada 2025, disusul Indonesia dengan 14%. Setelah melarang ekspor pada Februari–Oktober 2025, Kongo memberlakukan kuota 96.600 ton per tahun untuk 2026–2027, dikelola ARECOMS (otoritas regulator pasar mineral strategis Kongo).

Kargo yang sempat tertahan kemudian tiba di China hampir bersamaan. Ekspor kobalt Kongo naik dari 17.054 ton pada kuartal I menjadi 24.086 ton pada kuartal II 2026. Menurut Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, harga hidroksida kobalt di Asia turun 31% pada kuartal III menjadi US$17,25 per pon. Pada Agustus, Ketua ARECOMS Patrick Mpoyi Luabeya mengatakan kepada Fastmarkets bahwa kuota dapat dikurangi bila ketidakseimbangan pasar berlanjut.

Di Indonesia, kobalt adalah produk sampingan nikel dalam bentuk MHP (mixed hydroxide precipitate, endapan hidroksida nikel-kobalt) dari pabrik HPAL (high pressure acid leach, pelindian asam bertekanan tinggi). Per 8 Oktober, SMM (Shanghai Metals Market) mencatat payable kobalt MHP di level 58, yang menurut Mysteel terendah dalam sejarah. SMM menghitung MHP kini dijual di bawah biaya tunai produksinya. Kongo dan Indonesia menempuh jalan berbeda, kuota dan hilirisasi, tetapi bergantung pada pembeli yang sama: China.

posts.title: Jenewa, 1987: sebuah komisi yang seluruh anggotanya dari Selatan mulai menyusun strategi pembangunan untuk Selatan.
caption: Jenewa, 1987: sebuah komisi yang seluruh anggotanya dari Selatan mulai menyusun strategi pembangunan untuk Selatan.

Komisi Selatan lahir dari usulan Perdana Menteri Malaysia Mahathir Mohamad, yang diumumkan di KTT (Konferensi Tingkat Tinggi) GNB (Gerakan Non-Blok) Harare, September 1986. Mahathir lalu terbang ke Dar es Salaam membujuk mantan Presiden Tanzania Julius Nyerere untuk memimpinnya. Pada 27 Juli 1987 Nyerere mengumumkan 28 anggotanya, dengan Manmohan Singh dari India sebagai sekretaris jenderal. Sekretariatnya bekerja di Jenewa sejak 1 Agustus 1987.

Tiga tahun dan delapan rapat pleno kemudian, terbitlah The Challenge to the South (1990). Pesan dasarnya ditulis Nyerere di pengantar: tanggung jawab atas pembangunan Selatan ada di Selatan, di tangan rakyatnya sendiri. Laporan itu juga mengusulkan "Sekretariat Selatan" untuk menopang G77 (Kelompok 77, koalisi negara berkembang di PBB) dan GNB. Usulan itu menjadi South Centre, yang resmi berdiri sebagai organisasi antarpemerintah di Jenewa pada 1995.

Indonesia? Widjojo Nitisastro, mantan Ketua Bappenas (Badan Perencanaan Pembangunan Nasional), duduk sebagai anggota komisi. Jakarta menyumbang US$75.000 untuk kerja komisi, dan edisi Indonesianya terbit pada 1992 sebagai Tantangan yang Menghadang Selatan. Di masa Indonesia memimpin GNB, Jakarta membiayai kegiatan South Centre, ikut melobi Swiss, dan menjanjikan US$500.000 per tahun, sampai krisis 1997 memaksanya berhenti. Nyerere menyebut South Centre "bayiku". Ia wafat 14 Oktober 1999; Rabu ini Tanzania memperingati Hari Nyerere.

posts.title: Harare, September 1986: Gerakan Non-Blok bersidang di negara garis depan, di ambang pintu Afrika Selatan yang masih menjalankan apartheid.
caption: Harare, September 1986: Gerakan Non-Blok bersidang di negara garis depan, di ambang pintu Afrika Selatan yang masih menjalankan apartheid.

KTT (Konferensi Tingkat Tinggi) kedelapan GNB (Gerakan Non-Blok) digelar 1–6 September 1986, tepat 25 tahun setelah Beograd. Rajiv Gandhi menyerahkan kursi ketua kepada Perdana Menteri Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe. Ini KTT pertama di Afrika sub-Sahara sejak Lusaka 1970. Oliver Tambo dari ANC (Kongres Nasional Afrika) menyebut serah terima itu "menautkan New Delhi dan Harare".

Hasil paling konkret: Dana AFRICA (Action for Resisting Invasion, Colonialism and Apartheid; Aksi Melawan Invasi, Kolonialisme, dan Apartheid) untuk menopang negara garis depan menghadapi tekanan Pretoria. India memimpin komitenya, Zambia wakil ketua. Mugabe menyebutnya "pencapaian terpenting konferensi ini". Di Harare pula, PM Malaysia Mahathir Mohamad mengajukan usulan Komisi Selatan dan KTT mendukungnya; Julius Nyerere dari Tanzania memimpinnya mulai 1987.

Indonesia? Menurut CSIS Africa Notes, Jakarta sempat ingin menjadi tuan rumah 1986 tetapi mundur demi kandidat Afrika. Di Harare, delegasi dipimpin Wakil Presiden Umar Wirahadikusumah; ANRI (Arsip Nasional Republik Indonesia) menyimpan surat perjalanan dinasnya. Indonesia lalu bersaing dengan Nikaragua untuk KTT 1989, keputusan ditunda, dan pencalonan itu diganjal isu Timor Timur. Peneliti CSIS Jakarta, A.R. Sutopo, menulis pada 1987: "yang dicari adalah Bandung Kedua, bukan Havana atau Harare." Jakarta akhirnya menjadi tuan rumah KTT X pada 1992.

posts.title: Ghana ingin menghidupkan lagi smelter VALCO. Mitra teknis asal Malaysia dilaporkan mundur.
caption: Ghana ingin menghidupkan lagi smelter VALCO. Mitra teknis asal Malaysia dilaporkan mundur.

VALCO (Volta Aluminium Company) di Tema didirikan pada 1964 untuk memakai listrik Bendungan Akosombo, dengan kapasitas rancangan 200.000 ton aluminium per tahun. Pada Januari 2026, pemerintah menyebut produksinya sekitar 40.000 ton per tahun. Menurut GIADEC (Ghana Integrated Aluminium Development Corporation, BUMN aluminium Ghana), sel aktif turun dari 127 pada 2025 menjadi sekitar 90 pada Agustus 2026.

Pada 21 Agustus 2026 pemerintah melantik tim negosiasi untuk mencari mitra strategis. Draf term sheet yang dipublikasikan Soireenews menyebut konsorsium Arch dapat mengambil hingga 70% saham, GIADEC menyisakan minimal 30%, mengacu pada MoU (nota kesepahaman) 12 Agustus. ICU (Industrial and Commercial Workers' Union) menuntut proses dihentikan dan menyebut Press Metal (Malaysia), yang dianggap mitra teknis utama konsorsium, telah mundur.

Di sisi Asia, Coal India sedang mengevaluasi peluang bauksit Ghana; pada Agustus perusahaan negara India itu juga mendirikan CIL Global di Singapura untuk mengejar aset mineral di luar negeri. Ghana juga berunding dengan EGA (Emirates Global Aluminium) dan sejumlah perusahaan China. Ghana memiliki sekitar 920 juta ton bauksit, tetapi belum punya kilang alumina. Indonesia pernah menempuh jalur serupa lewat Inalum dan PLTA (pembangkit listrik tenaga air) Asahan.

posts.title: Nigeria’s central bank goes to Singapore looking for capital that stays.
caption: Nigeria’s central bank goes to Singapore looking for capital that stays.

On Oct. 8, Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Governor Olayemi Cardoso met the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on financial innovation with the Global Finance & Technology Network (GFTN), and convened a Nigeria–Asia Financial Connectivity Dialogue at J.P. Morgan’s Singapore offices with Nigerian Exchange Group (NGX) and FMDQ Group.

His pitch: “The real test of reform is not whether you can attract capital once; it is whether you create the confidence for capital to stay, return and grow.” He asked for closer ties between Nigerian and Asian banks, better payment and settlement channels, and more participation by Nigerians working across Asia.

Next stops: Beijing, where the CBN already holds a 15 billion yuan currency swap with the People’s Bank of China (PBoC), and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Oct. 12–18.
What to watch: the GFTN deal is still a framework, with no funding or projects named yet.

posts.title: New Delhi, Maret 1983: India mengambil kemudi Gerakan Non-Blok setelah Havana, dan agendanya bergeser dari soal blok ke soal ekonomi.
caption: New Delhi, Maret 1983: India mengambil kemudi Gerakan Non-Blok setelah Havana, dan agendanya bergeser dari soal blok ke soal ekonomi.

KTT (Konferensi Tingkat Tinggi) ketujuh GNB (Gerakan Non-Blok) semula dijadwalkan dibuka di Baghdad, 6 September 1982. Perang Iran–Irak membuat rencana itu batal, dan forum dipindah ke New Delhi. KTT digelar 7–12 Maret 1983 di Vigyan Bhavan. Bahama, Barbados, Kolombia, dan Vanuatu diterima sebagai anggota baru. Kursi Kamboja tetap kosong karena sengketa dua delegasi.

Fidel Castro, tuan rumah KTT Havana 1979, menyerahkan palu ketua kepada Indira Gandhi, lalu memeluknya di depan sidang. Dalam pidato kuncinya, Indira menyebut GNB "gerakan perdamaian terbesar dalam sejarah". Ia mencatat harga satu kapal induk nuklir, sekitar US$4 miliar, melebihi PDB (produk domestik bruto) tiap satu dari 53 negara, sebagian besar anggota GNB. "Kami di dunia berkembang tak punya margin keselamatan," katanya.

Indonesia? Inpres (Instruksi Presiden) No. 2/1983 menunjuk Menlu sebagai ketua delegasi, menilai prinsip GNB "terasa goyah", dan meminta delegasi memperjuangkan Tata Ekonomi Dunia Baru serta "kemandirian bersama" yang diserasikan dengan ASEAN. Soal Kamboja, Indonesia masih mengakui Kampuchea Demokratik. ANRI (Arsip Nasional Republik Indonesia) menyimpan naskah sambutan Presiden Soeharto untuk KTT ini, bertanggal 7 Maret 1983.

posts.title: Senegal wants to build the laptops and phones it now imports, with an Indian partner.
caption: Senegal wants to build the laptops and phones it now imports, with an Indian partner.

On Oct. 6 in Dakar, Senegal's telecoms and digital ministry signed a partnership worth nearly 88 billion CFA francs ($150 million) with GCIB for Africa, an investment council, and Hyderabad-based Blue Cloud Softech Solutions. It covers assembly, quality control, certification and intellectual property (IP), and aims to draw in about 200 Senegalese startups.
The centrepiece is a device assembly complex in Diamniadio, outside Dakar, due to open in December and make computers, smartphones and tablets, with first devices expected in early 2027.

The case is the import bill: about $720 million a year in computer equipment, according to the ministry. India offers the template, and the caution: phone output rose 33-fold in a decade, but domestic value added was 23% in 2023–24.

What to watch: this is a memorandum of understanding (MoU), not yet a factory. Funding splits, how deep local work goes beyond kit assembly, and whether prices fall for the 54% of Senegalese without a device.

posts.title: Havana, September 1979: Gerakan Non-Blok nyaris ditarik ke satu blok, dan suara Asia–Afrika yang menahannya.
caption: Havana, September 1979: Gerakan Non-Blok nyaris ditarik ke satu blok, dan suara Asia–Afrika yang menahannya.

Tiga tahun setelah Kolombo, GNB (Gerakan Non-Blok) menggelar KTT (Konferensi Tingkat Tinggi) keenam di Havana, Kuba, 3–9 September 1979, dipimpin Fidel Castro. Sebanyak 93 negara ambil bagian. Ini KTT GNB pertama di Amerika Latin, dan Kuba meresmikan Palacio de las Convenciones khusus untuk acara ini.

Tuan rumah ingin GNB menjalin "aliansi alami" dengan Blok Timur. Penolakan datang dari banyak arah. Tito dari Yugoslavia, salah satu pendiri gerakan, menyebut GNB "bukan, dan tidak bisa menjadi, ban berjalan atau cadangan blok mana pun". Julius Nyerere dari Tanzania mengingatkan bahwa gerakan ini progresif, tetapi bukan kelompok yang hanya untuk negara progresif, dan tidak boleh punya musuh permanen. Menlu India memperingatkan Castro bahwa ia tak bisa satu kaki berpihak dan satu kaki lagi non-blok. Burma kecewa berat: tiga minggu kemudian salah satu penggagas Konferensi Bandung itu keluar dari GNB.
Soal Kampuchea, kursinya dibiarkan kosong, tidak untuk rezim Pol Pot yang terguling maupun pemerintahan Heng Samrin yang naik setelah invasi Vietnam. Dua puluh delegasi memprotes keputusan ketua itu.

Indonesia? Wapres Adam Malik mewakili Indonesia, dengan pidato yang menegaskan kembali prinsip-prinsip Non-Blok. Inpres No. 19/1979 menyebut KTT Havana "titik kritis" bagi gerakan dan meminta delegasi bekerja sama dengan negara pendiri dan negara sehaluan untuk menjaga prinsip Non-Blok "yang murni".
Jejaknya: Myanmar (dulu Burma) kembali ke GNB pada 1992, tahun yang sama ketika Jakarta menjadi tuan rumah KTT X.

posts.title: Africa's largest bank is moving its core systems onto Huawei's cloud.
caption: Africa's largest bank is moving its core systems onto Huawei's cloud.

At HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 in Shanghai on 28 September, Standard Bank Group and Huawei widened a partnership they began in 2024 to cover application modernisation, cloud, data and artificial intelligence (AI). The substantive piece is core banking, the system of record for accounts, balances and transactions: Huawei and its software partners will help migrate it from legacy infrastructure to cloud architecture, in phases. AI use cases such as fraud detection and customer service remain areas to "explore". No contract value or timeline was disclosed.

The China link runs deeper than one contract. ICBC (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China) bought 20% of Standard Bank in 2008 for 36.7 billion rand. Huawei Cloud began commercial service from Johannesburg in 2019, the first global cloud provider to run a data centre in Africa, and added a Cairo region in June 2024. In late August, China opened the China–Africa Digital Technology Cooperation Center in Hangzhou, with about 300 delegates from 18 African countries.

"When technology lowers our cost to serve, it makes it commercially viable to reach communities that have historically been excluded from traditional financial services," said Funeka Montjane of Standard Bank.
The open question: where core banking data will sit across the bank's 21 African markets, as regulators tighten data-localisation rules.

posts.title: Africa speaks more than 2,000 languages. Its artificial intelligence (AI) is starting to learn them.
caption: Africa speaks more than 2,000 languages. Its artificial intelligence (AI) is starting to learn them.

On 2 October the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the GSMA, the global association of mobile operators, signed a partnership to scale African-led AI, including AI in African languages. Working through timbuktoo, UNDP's initiative for African innovators, they aim to widen access to compute (the processing power that trains and runs AI models) for priority pilots, link African talent to real applications, and help local tools reach users over mobile networks. No funding figure was announced.

The language work sits in ATLAS Umoja AI (African Tongues and Languages at Scale; umoja is Kiswahili for unity), launched in Abuja on 24 July with backing from Benin, Kenya, Namibia, Nigeria and Togo. Pilots cover Amharic, Malagasy, isiZulu, Pulaar and Kiswahili, and the models are open on Hugging Face.

Asia has walked this road. India's BHASHINI, the National Language Translation Mission launched in 2022, now offers voice in 22 languages and text in 36. In Indonesia, GoTo and the telco Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison released Sahabat-AI, a 70-billion-parameter open model for Indonesian, Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese and Batak, in June 2025.
The test for Africa: whether five pilot languages become national services, and whose compute they run on.

posts.title: Aljir, September 1973: Gerakan Non-Blok berhenti hanya bicara politik dan mulai menagih tatanan ekonomi dunia.
caption: Aljir, September 1973: Gerakan Non-Blok berhenti hanya bicara politik dan mulai menagih tatanan ekonomi dunia.

Tiga tahun setelah Lusaka, GNB (Gerakan Non-Blok) berkumpul di Aljir, 5–9 September 1973. KTT (Konferensi Tingkat Tinggi) keempat ini dipimpin Presiden Aljazair Houari Boumédiène dan dihadiri lebih dari 70 negara peserta. Deklarasi ekonominya mendukung nasionalisasi sebagai ekspresi kedaulatan negara; deklarasi politiknya meminta Sekjen PBB menggelar sidang istimewa soal pembangunan.

Sebulan kemudian, di tengah Perang Arab–Israel Oktober 1973, anggota Arab OPEC (Organisasi Negara-Negara Pengekspor Minyak) mengembargo minyak, dan harga minyak per barel naik hingga empat kali lipat. Pada 30 Januari 1974, Aljazair atas nama Kelompok Non-Blok meminta sidang istimewa PBB soal bahan mentah dan pembangunan. Sidang Istimewa Keenam dibuka 9 April 1974; pada 1 Mei 1974 Majelis Umum mengadopsi tanpa pemungutan suara Resolusi 3201 dan 3202 tentang NIEO (New International Economic Order, Tatanan Ekonomi Internasional Baru): kedaulatan penuh atas sumber daya alam, termasuk hak nasionalisasi, dan hubungan harga yang adil antara bahan mentah dan barang impor.

Dari Asia, Presiden Soeharto memilih tidak berangkat; delegasi Indonesia dipimpin Menteri Luar Negeri Adam Malik, dengan Jenderal Soemitro sebagai wakil ketua. Gagasan itu belum hilang: pada 2018 Majelis Umum PBB mengadopsi resolusi 73/240, "Towards a New International Economic Order".

Washington ikut menawar: pada 18 September, Menteri Pertambangan Bouna Sylla membahas peran DFC (U.S. International Development Finance Corporation) dan Export-Import Bank AS untuk kilang CBG. caption: India is exporting digital rails to Africa — identity, payments, and data exchange systems known as Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), or India Stack.

Six of those partners are African: Sierra Leone, Tanzania, Kenya, Ethiopia, The Gambia and Lesotho. India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is already live in over eight countries, including Mauritius.

UNDP estimates DPI could lift GDP in emerging economies by 20–30% by 2030 — and notes that about 500 million people on the continent still lack a verifiable digital identity. The Asia–Africa bridge here is not a product export. It is architecture, adaptation, and South–South practice.

posts.title: An Indian soda-ash giant has mined Kenya’s Lake Magadi for a generation. Nairobi now wants it to leave.
caption: An Indian soda-ash giant has mined Kenya’s Lake Magadi for a generation. Nairobi now wants it to leave.

Tata Chemicals Magadi — Africa’s largest natural soda-ash producer — sits on a concession that traces to a 1928 colonial lease covering more than 220,000 acres in Kajiado County. Tata, part of India’s Tata Group, acquired the plant in 2005. The company reports exports of more than 350,000 tonnes a year to India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and elsewhere in Africa, and about 500 direct jobs.

In July 2026 Kenya’s mining ministry suspended operations in a compliance review under the Mining Act — mineral rights, royalties, Community Development Agreement (CDA) committees, local processing and employment. In early September, President William Ruto told Tata to “pack up and leave,” saying a century of extraction had not delivered enough glass and chemical factories in Kajiado.

Alongside the national dispute, Kajiado County has pursued land rates and royalties (a Sh17.45 billion demand for 2013–18 was quashed by the Court of Appeal in October 2025 and remains in higher-court track). Maasai and Magadi residents press for grazing access, skilled jobs and clearer benefits — even as many still depend on company water, health and education support.
For Asian investors across Africa, Magadi is a live ESG and political-risk case: legacy leases, devolution and local politics can rewrite the bargain faster than any expansion plan.

caption: Senegal’s public debt reached about 132 percent of GDP by the end of 2024, after Dakar disclosed previously unreported borrowing. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) estimates misreported debt at more than $11 billion on an end-2023 base. A prior $1.8 billion IMF programme was frozen.

In September 2026, IMF staff and Senegal reached a staff-level agreement on a proposed $2.2 billion, 36-month Extended Credit Facility (ECF). The deal still needs Executive Board approval, corrective action on misreporting, and financing assurances. Senegal has also signalled a path to restore debt sustainability, including through an enhanced Common Framework treatment.

Meanwhile, the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) is shifting from writing Phase II rules — investment, digital trade, competition, intellectual property — toward implementation. That matters for Asia: China was reported as Senegal’s top goods supplier in 2024, and Chinese firms are pushing deeper local anchoring in West Africa. A single African market is a larger door than a single bilateral shelf.

posts.title: Women sit at the core of Kenya’s economy — in labour, in micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), and in informal trade. Capital still treats them as the margin.
caption: Women sit at the core of Kenya’s economy — in labour, in micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), and in informal trade. Capital still treats them as the margin.

In 2024, female labour-force participation stood at about 62.2 percent, against 71.4 percent for men. Women-owned MSMEs accounted for 57.6 percent of Kenya’s MSMEs; MSMEs contribute roughly 40 percent of GDP (gross domestic product). Women’s financial inclusion reached 84.1 percent — yet Kenya Bankers Association data show women are 48 percent of MSME borrowers and hold only 26 percent of outstanding MSME credit. Average loans: about KES 392,000 for women versus KES 742,000 for men.
The World Bank estimates closing education and labour-market gender gaps could raise Kenya’s GDP by up to 10 percent.

The Asia–Africa bridge already exists: the International Trade Centre (ITC) SheTrades Kenya Hub, hosted by Absa, sits in a network that includes India, Indonesia, Bangladesh and other Asian hubs. Since 2016, Absa–ITC training reached more than 8,500 women; financing support for over 10,400 exceeded $23 million. Kenya–India SME and technology missions via the Kenya National Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KNCCI) are expanding the same lane.
Inclusion without capital is not partnership. Swipe for the briefing.
